tables.label: TABLE 2
tables.caption: Synergistic effect between brevibacillin 2V and antibiotics.
footnotes: aThe MIC was determined by broth microdilution.
FICI, fractional inhibitory concentration index [FICI = (MIC compound A in combination with B / MIC compound A) + (MIC compound B in combination with A / MIC compound B)].

The FICI value suggests a synergistic (≤0.5), addictive (>0.5–1), no interaction (1–4), and antagonism (>4) effect of the two compounds. The italic font indicates the best synergy effect among the tests.
